title: Supply and Maintenance of High-Performance Server Infrastructure
description: Procurement, deployment, and 3-year warranty maintenance of high-performance enterprise compute cluster servers for state data centre.
organization: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
entity: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)

requirements.title: GST Registration
requirements.description: Bidder must possess active GST registration in the state of supply.

requirements.title: Udyam / MSME Registration
requirements.description: Active Udyam registration certificate for MSE exemption benefits.

requirements.title: Minimum Annual Turnover
requirements.description: Average annual turnover of at least ₹5 Crore in last 3 financial years.

requirements.title: Similar Project Experience
requirements.description: Minimum 3 successfully completed similar server/compute deployments.

requirements.title: OEM Authorization Certificate
requirements.description: Tender-specific Manufacturer Authorization Form from OEM.
